ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, contrasted against a low-intensity (black) perimeter along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity field across the central fluke. Low-intensity continuous band along the trailing edge. Four distinct low-intensity circular focal spots: two located medially on the left lobe and two located medially on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a deep pixel-depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern consisting of small peaks and valleys along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the proximal notch trailing toward the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Four discrete, low-intensity circular pixel clusters detected symmetrically in the mid-region of the high-intensity ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized dark pigmentation spots (four) visible on the otherwise high-intensity ventral surface.
